03What She Delivers

Vocalist, performer, headliner

The vocalist

A trained, controlled voice — comparisons to Asa, India.Arie, and Erykah Badu are consistent, not one-off.

The headliner

Five years, monthly, at one venue. A residency, not a one-off booking.

The studio approach

Real players over programmed sound — a live string quartet on her debut EP.

The Foundation — Lagos, 2015–2021

Trained under Akapo Emmanuel at Tenstrings Music Institute from 2015. Released debut singles "Jeje" and "Endlessly" in July 2016 at 17, and was named Tenstrings Artist of the Year.

Sources: SoundCloud · Tenstrings

Performed live, monthly, at Freedom Park Lagos for five years — a residency built on trust, not one-off bookings. Headlined her own show, "BIBI Live In Concert." Played Felaboration, Nigeria's largest annual music festival. Shared stages with Majek Fashek and Yinka Davies. Interviewed by BBC News Pidgin. Featured on "Your View," "Wake Up Nigeria," Popcentral TV, and Sunrise TV. Performed for Make Music Lagos, sponsored by MTN Nigeria.

Sources: Freedom Park · BIBI Live In Concert · Felaboration · Majek Fashek · BBC Pidgin · Your View · Wake Up Nigeria · Popcentral · Sunrise TV · MTN/Make Music Lagos

Released debut EP Monophobia in July 2020, backed by a live string quartet. Profiled by Niji Magazine and Nigerian Tribune, the latter under the headline "Bibi Set to Takeover Afro-Soul World."

Sources: Apple Music · Niji Magazine · Nigerian Tribune

Brought that same discipline to the United States.

05About

Bibi is a vocalist first — the instrument came before the career. Trained at Tenstrings Music Institute under Akapo Emmanuel, her phrasing draws comparisons to Asa, India.Arie, and Erykah Badu.

Her sound fuses Soul, Afro, Pop, and R&B — built on live players, including a full string quartet on her debut EP, rather than programmed sound. Early write-ups called her stage presence electrifying.

She continues building an independent catalog and performance calendar as BibiCentric. Alongside music, she runs The Exquisite Gift Company, a gifting business.

"My voice is my instrument, and I see it as a gift that allows me to connect with people, tell stories, and express emotions that words alone sometimes cannot."

— Bibi

"My mom showed me what music could be. It's been the one place I feel fully myself ever since — and I love that a song can reach someone I'll never even meet."

— Bibi
